test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which state did India's White Revolution have its origin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The White Revolution was started in 1970**__.

 __
 
• It was an initiative of the National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) of India and was the largest dairy development program in the world.
 
• This is known as Operation Flood.
 
• It transformed India from a milk deficient country to the largest milk producer in the world.
 
• Operation Flood was based on the experimental pattern established by Verghese Kurien.
 
• **The Amul-Anand Milk Union Limited Gujarat-based collaboration was the engine that drove the success of the Operation Flood program**__.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gujarat**__

 
 
• ​Capital: Gandhinagar
 
• National Parks: Vansda National Park, Blackbuck National Park, Gir National Park, Marine National Park.
 
• State Animal: Asiatic Lion
 
• State Bird: Greater Flamingo
 
• State Tree: Disputed Various official websites disagree on state tree.
 
• State Flower: Marigold
